entities.summary: Paul Shaffer (b. 1949-11-28, Thunder Bay) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Thunder Bay and Canada. Known in the fields of canada, composers & musicians, americas.
